Package com.example.syntaxio.model

Class Hint

java.lang.Object
com.example.syntaxio.model.Hint
public class Hint extends Object
Represents an assistance request response for a specific coding challenge.

A hint stores the text shown to the learner, the type of support requested, an estimated confidence score, whether the learner marked it as helpful, and the time it was requested.

  • Constructor Details

    • Hint

      public Hint(String challengeId, String hintText, String hintType, int confidence)
      Creates a hint for a challenge and initializes tracking metadata.

      The hint id is generated automatically, wasHelpful defaults to false, and requestedAt is set to the current time.

      Parameters:
      challengeId - identifier of the challenge this hint belongs to
      hintText - learner-facing hint content
      hintType - hint category, usually GENERAL, PSEUDOCODE, or DOCUMENTATION
      confidence - confidence score from 0 to 100
